abstract.text: The edges of a graph, or a contiguous run of them. Positions are edge indices. Iterating
decodes each row once, O(1) amortized per edge; subscripting one position is O(log n +
out-degree), so prefer iteration to index loops.
An immutable directed graph on the vertices
whose rows of successors are Elias–Fano
coded (Elias 1974, Fano 1971; Vigna, “Quasi-succinct indices”, WSDM 2013), as WebGraph’s
stores them: each row’s ascending targets split into
